confidence_notes: Food anchors use recent Taiwan-wide aggregates and limited Kenting price references. Accommodation is a holistic July estimate with uncertainty from seasonal and weekend demand. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated as multiples of local draft beer rather than reliable citywide averages.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kenting-specific price data are sparse, so food estimates use Taiwan-wide typical prices adjusted for a coastal resort town; accommodation is estimated holistically for summer demand.
